name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $75,900, 12% off its high; no stablecoin de-peg
state: Bitcoin was near $75,900 early on 7 Nov, 12.3% below its 52-week high and 1% lower on the week, inside the 25% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). No stablecoin de-peg or major exchange failure had been reported as of 7 Nov.
for_you: Crypto prices remain volatile but there is no sign of a market-wide failure. Describes market conditions only; it is not advice.
rubric_hit: BTC drawdown 12.3% below the 25% Watch line
why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
